scope: Harness-lifecycle bug fixes (bead cr-tr1v), from the defects table of the 2026-11-20 harness review: build-a-lever frontmatter quoted for strict YAML, the curation playbook and harness-evaluate state one first-adoption order, and the eval classifier stops crediting a failed shell write. No report and no upstream trait rows (README 4a playbook exemption).
method: Defects fixed test-first; each fix proven red on the old code and green on the new.

subject: ours:build-a-lever
why: Harness review defect: the description held an unquoted colon and space, so strict YAML rejected the frontmatter while the catalog line parser accepted it. The value is now quoted; text unchanged. skill-catalog.py now parses every skill frontmatter as YAML before building entries. Its tree hash is refreshed in traits/ours.yaml.

subject: ours:harness-evaluate
why: Harness review defect: it said to record adopt only after the adopted state exists, against the curation playbook ruling-first gate. It now follows the playbook order: owner ruling, pending adopt, build and verify, delivered adopt superseding the pending one; a whole-capability adopt-merged, which has no pending form, is recorded once the adopted state exists. Traits unchanged. Its tree hash is refreshed in traits/ours.yaml.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/skill-curation.md
why: Harness review defect: section 2 gave two orders for a first adoption (ruling before the change, and adopt waiting for the adopted state). It now states one: owner ruling, pending adopt event, build and verify, delivered adopt event in the same change as the edit; a ruling with no pending form is recorded once the adopted state exists. Steps and traits unchanged.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/eval.md
why: Harness review defect in its reference script eval/classify.py: a matching shell write whose tool result was an error still counted as an edit. Edit credit now needs a successful result; a failed one is kept as evidence under edit_attempts. Playbook text, steps and traits unchanged.
